items.stem: When estimating the mean from a grouped frequency table, each value is assumed to equal
items.answer: the midpoint of its class

items.stem: Explain why the mean calculated from a grouped frequency table is only an estimate.

items.stem: Explain why the median of grouped data found by interpolation is only an estimate.

items.stem: The annual salaries, in thousands of dollars, of the 12 employees of a small company in Jakarta are: 30, 32, 33, 33, 35, 36, 37, 39, 40, 41, 42, 188. (a) The company wants to attract new staff. State, with a reason, which average it might quote in an advertisement. (b) State which average best represents the salary of a typical employee, giving a reason. (c) Find the mean salary of the other employees if the salary of 188 is excluded.
items.answer: (a) the mean (48.8), since it is higher because of the large salary 188 (b) the median (36.5), as it is not affected by the outlier 188 (c) 36.2
items.markingKey: (a) B1 mean; B1 reason: inflated by the high salary [2] (b) B1 median; B1 not affected by the extreme value [2] (c) M1 (586 − 188) ÷ 11; A1 36.2 [2]

items.stem: Find the mean of 1, 4, 6, 15, 18, 21, 23, 23, 25, 27, 28 correct to 3 significant figures.
A frequency table of the number of goals gives x: 0, 1, 2, 3; frequency: 6, 13, 6, 10. Mei says that the mode is 13. Explain the mistake, and find the mode and the mean.
items.answer: 13 is the highest frequency, not a value of x; the mode is 1 and the mean is 1.57.
items.markingKey: B1 mode is the value with the highest frequency, 1; B1 mean 1.57

items.stem: For 15 values of x, Σ(x − 25) = −57. Find the mean of x.
For 37 values, Σ(x − 60) = −122. Isla calculates the mean as 60 − (−122)/37 = 63.3. Explain the error and find the correct mean.
items.answer: x − 60 has mean (−122)/37, so x̄ = 60 + (−122)/37 = 56.7; the sign was wrong.
items.markingKey: B1 should add the coded mean; B1 x̄ = 56.7

items.stem: For 35 values, Σ(x − 40) = −29. Amara says the mean of x is −0.829. Explain the error and find the correct mean.
items.answer: −0.829 is the mean of x − 40; 40 must be added back: x̄ = 39.2.
items.markingKey: B1 that is the coded mean; B1 x̄ = 39.2

items.stem: A shop records the shoe sizes sold in one day: size: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8; frequency: 9, 6, 14, 2, 11, 9. The mean size is 5.53. Explain why the mode is a more useful average for the shop manager, and state its value.
items.answer: Sizes are discrete and the shop needs the size it sells most; the mean 5.53 is not an actual size. The mode is 5.
items.markingKey: B1 mean is not a stocked size / manager needs most popular; B1 mode 5

items.stem: The data are the times, in minutes, that 9 patients waited at a clinic in Riyadh: 41, 41, 42, 44, 48, 49, 54, 55, 158. Mateo says the mean, 59.1, is the best average to describe a typical waiting time. Explain why Mateo is wrong and state a better average, giving its value.
items.answer: The value 158 is an outlier which pulls the mean above most of the data; the median, 48, is a better typical value.
